-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27

-- w/l/c/c.lgo --
package c

var owned = []int{1, 2, 3}

func Base() const []int {
	return owned
}

func Sum(xs const []int) int {
	total := 0
	for _, v := range xs {
		total += v
	}
	return total
}

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- w/g/q/q.go --
package q

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/l/c"
)

func Run() string {
	b := c.Base()
	first := c.Sum(b)
	b[0] = 9
	second := c.Sum(b)
	return fmt.Sprintf("%d/%d", first, second)
}

-- w/g/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/g/q"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(q.Run())
}

-- neg/go.mod --
module example.com/neg

go 1.27

-- neg/neg.lgo --
package neg

func Bad(xs const []int) {
	xs[0] = 1
}
